description: Retrieves a list of sets, or more information about a particular one. params must be a JSON string shaped like GetSetsParamsObject. userHash is optional and is only used with user-specific filters such as owned or wanted.

parameters.name: userHash
parameters.description: Optional user hash; used with user-specific filters such as owned or wanted.

parameters.name: params
parameters.description: JSON-encoded parameter object. Stringify an object shaped like GetSetsParamsObject.
